# Portfolio Architecture & Data Contract
> Standard machine-readable context for Local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Cursor). Token budget: < 150 tokens.

## System Architecture
This portfolio decouples content from presentation:
- `data/projects.json`: Array of project objects for the main gallery and kinetic reel.
- `data/profile.json`: Architect & interior designer profile, philosophy, services, and credentials.
- `index.html`: Gallery UI (Kinetic Reel + Filterable Grid) rendering `data/projects.json`.
- `about.html`: Editorial page rendering `data/profile.json`.
- `admin.html`: In-browser CMS for editing projects and profile.

## Project Schema (`data/projects.json`)
```json
{
  "id": "proj-xx",
  "slug": "kebab-case-title",
  "title": "Full Project Title",
  "spine": "Short Single Word Title",
  "category": "Architecture | Interior Design",
  "type": "Residential | Commercial | Cultural | Hospitality",
  "year": "YYYY",
  "client": "Client Name",
  "role": "Lead Architect | Interior Designer",
  "location": "City, Country",
  "area": "XXX sqm",
  "materials": "Comma-separated key materials",
  "coverImage": "images/tm-620-com-xx.jpg",
  "galleryImages": ["path1", "path2"],
  "description": "1-2 sentence core architectural summary",
  "details": "1-2 sentences on spatial layout, lighting, or structural innovation"
}
```

## Local LLM Instruction Rule
When adding or updating content, DO NOT modify HTML files. Only output or update the minimal JSON object according to the schema above.
